encounter: P12 play_order 139, E0165 TRAINER_PARKER (Petalburg Gym room 2 - the slow room, guarded), cap 42
availability_audit: Petalburg Gym is challenged in C27; the cap is still 42 because Norman's Balance Badge, which raises it to 48, is awarded at the end of this Gym. No Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map walked by C26. Houndoominite stone-window 42; Mega Ring from Steven in C13. Route 118 and New Mauville sources excluded. No legendary or mythical is used.
plan: Deliberately NOT a stall party. At play_order 138 I found that a single Ghost with a burn beats a room of Normal attackers because the AI kept selecting 0x moves; repeating that would produce a meaningless benchmark, so this party is built to actually fight. Parker's six are five Psychic-or-part-Psychic bodies plus Lickilicky, which means Dark is 2x into four of them and Ghost is 2x into five - and unlike room 1, Ghost STAB is live here rather than blanked. Mega Houndoom and Weavile are the Dark half and both are immune to Psychic outright; Aegislash and Chandelure are the Ghost half. Aegislash is in the party specifically to exploit Parker's own Trick Room: it is Quiet-natured and slow, so when Oranguru reverses the speed order Aegislash moves first, and Ghost/Steel is immune to Body Slam, Double-Edge, Hyper Voice, Drain Punch and Hammer Arm. Two priority moves are carried on purpose as tests rather than as plans - Incineroar's Fake Out and Weavile's Ice Shard should both FAIL against Farigiraf's Armor Tail. No Grass move is on the party at all, because Girafarig's Sap Sipper would absorb it and gain Attack. Togekiss is the Earthquake insurance for the Instruct loop.
